blocks.text: Calibration should be repeated after the unit is moved to another room. The companion app stores usage history for ninety days unless you export it. Calibration should be repeated after the unit is moved to another room. Do not expose the unit to direct sunlight for extended periods.

Replacement filters can be ordered from authorised resellers only. Calibration should be repeated after the unit is moved to another room. Firmware updates are delivered over the air and install automatically at night. A factory reset erases every saved profile and restores the default schedule. The device must be charged for at least four hours before first use.
Unplug the unit before opening the case.
Use only the supplied power adapter.
